fields.name: selected_target
fields.description: Store one [y, x] point identifying the target on which the goal-named cube was placed at the goal-requested ordinal during the demonstration. Count completed placements onto targets chronologically, not frames, initial cube positions, flyovers, button presses, or the final release onto the unmarked central workspace. Identify a placement by lowering the carried cube onto a target and releasing it. Identify the physical marked target that received the requested placement, then track that target through all remaining demonstration frames and into the first execution scene, including large shuffles, temporary occlusion, and small apparent coordinate shifts. Establish consistent one-to-one correspondences among targets in successive frames using their motion jointly, keeping stationary targets separate. Neither coordinate-list order nor occupation of a previous target location establishes identity. Use the tracked physical target's center in the first execution scene as the canonical stored [y, x] point, not its placement-time location. If the visible sequence genuinely cannot establish the requested target's identity, write "unknown". Write this point at decision step #1 and retain it unchanged at every subsequent decision step. For episodes 18, 22, 46, 49, and 60 respectively, the values at both steps are [116, 163], [114, 168], [122, 132], [108, 87], and [136, 82]. e.g. [116, 163]
